sourceLineage.origin: Stem official investor relations Q2 2026 results

observations: Stem reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $140M-$190M revenue, 40%-50% non-GAAP gross margin, $10M-$15M adjusted EBITDA, $0-$10M operating cash flow and $65M-$70M year-end ARR.
Stem disclosed a North American BESS control-stack co-marketing agreement with Nuvation Energy and acquisition of raicoon assets to add automated fault detection/event management.

The 2025 10-K says the shift toward AI-enabled software, edge and services reduced historical battery-resale revenue and carries execution risk; the company had a $1.489B accumulated deficit at 2025 year-end.
risks: guidance remains non-GAAP-heavy and cash-flow range is near breakeven
contradictions: Growth narrative around software intelligence coexists with explicit 10-K warning that the strategic transition caused disruption and may fail to deliver anticipated benefits.
unknowns: organic versus acquired contribution to ARR
durability of positive adjusted EBITDA and operating cash flow

recommendation.reason: Primary current guidance plus 10-K risk evidence materially narrows execution uncertainty; Alpha can now build source-addressed underwriting without treating adjusted metrics as GAAP economics.
